text:
Priya: Heads-up: support reported that the onboarding KB page /guides/runtime/getting-started has a dead anchor and one diagram returning 403 after yesterdays CDN migration. Saw it while testing a fresh signup flow.
Omar: Which anchor? Can you paste the link?
Priya: Link -> https://kb.redwood.ai/guides/runtime/getting-started#cli-setup -> 404. Diagram at /static/images/runtime-flow.svg returns 403. I reproduced in staging.
docs-bot: nightly-link-scan: detected 2 dead anchors and 1 asset 403 on /guides/runtime/getting-started (scan-id: linkscan-2026-03-20-22). Anchors: #cli-setup (404), #env-vars (404). Asset: /static/images/runtime-flow.svg -> 403.
Tess: Reassigning to @Omar for the page owner follow-up. Omar, quick triage steps: 1) check frontmatter redirects, 2) run linkcheck locally, 3) preview PR.
Omar: On it. Running linkcheck now. If it's the CDN shortlink rewrite, we may need to replace shortlinks with canonical paths in the MD.
infra-bot: FYI: CDN migration logs show a shortlink rewrite job executed at 2026-03-19T03:12Z. Some S3 ACLs were temporarily tightened for private-preview domains.
Omar: Thanks infra-bot. I'll try swapping the image path to /assets/diagrams/runtime-flow.svg in a micro-PR and add a redirect entry for the dead anchor. Will do a canary deploy.
Priya: Customer impact: a new customer couldn't complete the CLI step in onboarding. Would like a quick rollback path if the PR causes issues.
Omar: Plan: open tiny PR updating anchors and image path + frontmatter redirect, request review, deploy preview for QA, and ask infra to confirm GETs for the asset.
(40m later) Omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201 1 updates: path fixes, anchor normalization, added redirect for old shortlink. Tagging @Tess and @Priya for review.
Tess: Quick skim LGTM. @infra can you validate the asset bucket ACLs for the preview domain?
infra-bot: Ops action: checked bucket policies; runtime-assets bucket had a deny rule for preview.* domain. Toggled allow-list for preview domain and verified HEAD/GET succeed.
Omar: Verified preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/guides/runtime/getting-started?pr=4201 1 anchor resolves, diagram loads.
Priya: Verified in staging with a fresh signup flow. Updating the Zendesk ticket (#4289) and marking ready-for-close.
Tess: Small follow-up: can we add a sanity-check to our docs deploy checklist: run linkcheck post-CDN-migration? I'll file an issue unless someone else beats me to it.
Omar: Filed issue #1001: "Post-CDN migration docs linkcheck step" and added a checklist item in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md.
Priya: Thanks all. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
